text:
Maria: kicking off a field-lab pilot with Arcturus to validate perf-per-watt + latency across four software configs. Need a run plan, telemetry tag spec, kernel patch windows, and clear pass/fail criteria. @TJ can you own run orchestration? @Nisha can you own telemetry schema? I'll loop legal about a short data-share addendum.

TJ: on it — I'll set up a run-matrix doc. quick q: which models/seq lengths should we include? do we measure streaming tail latency as well? :thinking_face:

Maria: keep it focused: two representative models — small-chat (7B) and instr-tune (13B). seq=512 and seq=2048. Metrics: p50/p95 latency, throughput (tokens/sec), perf/W (watts per 1k tokens) and energy per request. Measure cold vs warm KV cache.

Lucas: kernel-tuning note: propose a 3-day uninterrupted window per candidate kernel patch where we run full matrix and rollback point-by-point. We'll need access to partner kernel-dev nodes (non-prod) for iterative builds.

Nisha: telemetry schema draft is ready. we'll emit JSONL with fields: run_id, config, model, seq, tokens, p50_ms, p95_ms, avg_power_w, energy_j, throughput_tps, kv_cache_hit_rate, notes. dropping a one-line sample now: 
```
{"run_id":"r1","model":"7B","seq":512,"p95_ms":230,"avg_power_w":250.3} 
```

arcturus-eng: we can provide two racks and PDUs for power telemetry. kernel-dev nodes available Tue–Thu next week. we'll need a short NDA addendum for raw power telemetry sharing. we'll also confirm SSH access method.

Maria: good — partnerships/legal will draft the addendum. proposed timeline: week 1 dry-run in our lab (validate tooling + schema), week 2 partner-run (Arcturus lab), week 3 cross-validate + consolidate report. acceptance: tuned kernel should show >=10% perf/W improvement with <=5% increase in p95 latency.

TJ: :thumbsup: i'll create the run matrix + calendar invites. quick product question — for the joint marketplace/blog do we want aggregated curves or absolute power numbers?

Lucas: prefer plots (throughput vs power curves) and a short methods note. avoid publishing raw watt readings if partner asks — use normalized perf/W and relative improvements.

Nisha: adding telemetry tags: env:fieldlab, partner:arcturus, run_cohort:pilot1. that'll make post-filtering easy.

deploy-bot: Event created: fieldlab-power-pilot Kickoff — Tue 10:00. Invitees: Maria, TJ, Lucas, Nisha, arcturus-eng. Link: https://cal.company/meet/2798765432

Maria: :rocket: action items — @TJ: run-matrix doc + invites; @Nisha: push telemetry schema to shared doc; @Lucas: kernel window + patch plan; partnerships/legal: NDA addendum. i'll update objectives in the shared doc. sync tomorrow 11:00 for final sign-off.

arcturus-eng: we'll provision PDUs and send SSH keys to @TJ before Monday. one thing: some dev nodes run an older libc; can you confirm model binary compatibility?

TJ: i'll run a compatibility smoke on Monday. fallback plan: use container images if libc mismatch. smoke command i'll run:
```
./run_inference --model /mnt/models/7b --seq 512 --profile-power --warmup 50
```

Maria: perfect. please keep coordination here in this thread — avoids fragmented threads. :eyes:
